Pragma directives are compiler instructions in AL that control compilation behavior. Use this page to understand #pragma warning (for disabling/restoring warnings) and #pragma implicitwith (for managing with statement handling).

The #pragma implicitwith directive controls whether the AL compiler creates implicit with contexts, allowing developers to disable implicit binding and require qualified references for records during code migration.

Pragma warning directives suppress or restore specific AL compiler warnings in Business Central extensions. Use when you cannot address a warning's root cause, but be cautious as warnings can become errors in later releases.
Region Directives for Organizing AL Code
Region directives (#region and #endregion) organize AL code into collapsible blocks to improve readability and focus in large files. Use them to mark and document sections of code.

AL Preprocessor Directives enable conditional compilation, warning suppression, and code organization through conditional directives, regions, and pragmas. Use them to compile code conditionally based on defined symbols and create collapsible code regions.

Business Central integrates with multiple Azure services including Application Insights, Blob Storage, File Services, Functions, Key Vault, Virtual Networks, and Azure OpenAI Service for extended capabilities.
Integrating with infrastructure services describes how to connect Business Central with Azure services including Entra ID, security service tags, Application Insights, and Universal Print.

Integration overview describes architectural patterns and approaches for integrating Business Central with external systems using REST APIs, web services, Office apps, Power Platform, Dataverse, Dynamics 365 Sales and Field Service, Shopify, Azure services, and Copilot extensions.

Integrating with Office apps and Microsoft 365 covers integration capabilities with Excel, OneDrive, Outlook, SharePoint, Teams, Word, and Microsoft Graph for data management and document processing.

The AMC Banking 365 Fundamentals extension converts bank data into formats required by over 600 banks worldwide, facilitating payment transfers and bank reconciliation. Use it to export payment journal data and import reconciled bank statements.

The C5 data migration extension simplifies moving customers, vendors, items, and general ledger accounts from Microsoft Dynamics C5 2012 to Business Central. It handles historical GL entries and related transaction data with options to aggregate older transactions.

The Ceridian Payroll Extension enables import of payroll transactions from Ceridian HR/Payroll (US) and Ceridian PowerPay (Canada) services into the General Journal for posting to the general ledger.

Cloud migration extensions enable migrating on-premises solutions to Business Central online. Use product-specific extensions for Business Central on-premises or Dynamics GP, then configure cloud environment and migrate data.

The Dynamics GP Data Migration Extension (deprecated in 15.3 update) previously migrated data from Dynamics GP to Business Central. Users should now use the Cloud Migration wizard instead for more robust functionality.
Display actionable insights in Role Centers

The Essential Business Insights extension displays newspaper-like headlines showing interesting business facts in Role Centers, such as top-selling items, largest sales orders, and sales trends. Use it to quickly spot actionable insights from your company data.

The Image Analyzer extension uses Computer Vision API to automatically detect and suggest attributes in imported item and contact person images, helping quickly categorize and describe inventory and contacts.

The Cloud Migration base extension configures connections between on-premises solutions and Business Central online to enable data migration from on-premises to the cloud. Use it as the first step when migrating to Business Central online.

The Late Payment Prediction extension uses machine learning to predict whether customer payments will be late, helping optimize collection strategies. It displays confidence levels for predictions and can use standard Microsoft models or custom Azure-based models.

The Microsoft Pay extension adds payment links to sales documents for easier customer payments. Note: This extension was deprecated as of February 8, 2020, and customers should migrate to the PayPal extension instead.

Using the PayPal Payments Standard Extension
PayPal Payments Standard extension that enables customers to pay invoices through PayPal accounts with automatic links in sales documents and automatic payment registration capability.

The QuickBooks Payroll File Import extension imports payroll transactions from QuickBooks into Business Central general ledger accounts. Use it when transitioning from QuickBooks or outsourcing payroll while maintaining internal tracking.

Use the Sales and Inventory Forecast extension to predict future sales based on historical data and determine optimal replenishment quantities to avoid stockouts.
Send Remittance Advice Extension | Microsoft Docs

The Send Remittance Advice extension enables bulk emailing of remittance advice to vendors from payment journals and vendor ledger entries. Use it to notify vendors of payments via document sending profiles in supported countries.
Using the tax file formats (DK) extension
The tax file formats (DK) extension enables Danish companies to export VAT and Intrastat reports in formats compatible with SKAT and Statistics Denmark requirements.

The VAT Group Management extension for the United Kingdom enables multiple businesses to combine VAT reporting under a single registration number through a VAT group arrangement with a representative. Use this to coordinate VAT returns for UK-based company groups.

The WorldPay Payments Standard extension adds WorldPay payment links to sales invoices for convenient customer payments. Note: This extension was marked obsolete in 2023 release wave 2 and will be removed after three major releases.
Payment Reconciliation With the Envestnet Yodlee Bank Feeds Extension

The Envestnet Yodlee Bank Feeds extension links bank accounts to online banking for automatic or manual bank statement import into reconciliation journals. Use it to streamline payment reconciliation in the United States and Canada.

Track carbon emissions for fixed assets through acquisition, reclassification, and disposal. Emissions are recorded from purchase documents or fixed asset journals and follow the asset through its lifecycle.
Sustainability value chain in item journals
Record item emissions and reclassifications in item journals to create sustainability value entries. The Adjust Emissions batch job recalculates average CO2e per unit from posted entries.
Sustainability value chain in production enables tracking of CO2e emissions through production BOMs, routings, and production orders to calculate embedded carbon in manufactured items.

Sustainability value chain overview describes the features for tracking Scope 3 emissions through vendor data, calculating embedded carbon across purchase, transfer, production, assembly, and sales processes using average or specific carbon tracking methods.

Sustainability value chain in purchasing enables recording emissions from purchase documents and vendors, calculating CO2e using average or specific tracking methods, and posting sustainability value entries.

Sustainability value chain in sales calculates and tracks emissions for sold items using average or specific carbon tracking methods, with optional sales document layouts that display embedded carbon footprint.
Sustainability value chain in Service Management
Service Management tracks CO2e for items and resources in service documents, calculates total emissions based on quantities, and creates sustainability value entries for posted service transactions.
Sustainability value chain setup configures carbon tracking methods, enables emissions on master data records, and establishes emission fees with CO2e equivalency factors for all greenhouse gases.

Sustainability value chain in transfers records CO2e emissions from transfer operations, tracks carbon through item movements using average or specific tracking methods, and creates sustainability value entries.
